newsitem.title: THAILAND: Burmese workers killed in Thai accident.
newsitem.headline: Burmese workers killed in Thai accident.

text.p: At least 21 ethnic Mon and Karen Burmese workers were killed and 17 injured in an accident at the Thai-Burmese border, a Thai police official said on Friday.

The accident in Thailand's western Kanchanaburi province occurred when a truck carrying the workers to a construction site hit a lorry, the head of the provincial police, Colonel Virat Watcharakhachorn, told Reuters.
Most of the victims were believed to be among a large number of illegal immigrants who had crossed the border to seek employment, he said. Further details were not available.
